channel.description: Pryde's EasiFeed Elite 300 ® pellet is a low dose rate horse vitamin mineral supplement with 30% premium quality protein for working horses. Contains a full spectrum of nutrients to balance any diet including Sel-Plex® organic selenium, Bio-Chrome™ organic chromium and Yea-Sacc® live yeast culture.
